Name: UI.Voice.Status.NotInRoom
RU: Голосовой чат подключается в комнате. Для передачи удерживайте назначенную кнопку.
EN: Voice chat connects when you join a room. Hold your assigned key to talk.
Context: Voice backend status; no network session/capture is started by displaying this text.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.NoMicrophone
RU: Микрофон не удалось подключить. Проверьте разрешение доступа и устройство Windows.
EN: Could not connect the microphone. Check the Windows input device and microphone permission.
Context: Voice backend could not register the local capture device.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.Disabled
Context: Voice chat disabled by saved local preference.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.SelfMuted
Context: Local self-mute is enabled; receiving other players remains possible.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.Recording
Context: Network recording gate is enabled by PTT or open-microphone policy; not a claim that someone is currently speaking.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.PTTReady
EN: Hold your assigned key to talk.
Context: Registered local microphone with push-to-talk currently released.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.Unavailable
RU: Голос Steam недоступен в этой сессии. Проверьте Steam и настройки микрофона.
EN: Steam voice is unavailable in this session. Check Steam and your microphone settings.
Context: The current Steam session does not expose an available voice interface.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.CaptureOverflow
RU: Буфер микрофона переполнен. Запустите проверку заново.
EN: The microphone buffer overflowed. Restart the microphone test.
Context: Exclusive local microphone test stopped after an excessive capture buffer.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.CaptureError
RU: Ошибка микрофона. Проверьте разрешение доступа в Windows.
EN: Microphone error. Check microphone permission in Windows.
Context: The exclusive offline test received an error/uninitialized capture state.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.TestOfflineOnly
RU: Проверка микрофона доступна до входа в комнату, чтобы тест не слышали другие игроки.
EN: Test your microphone before joining a room, so other players cannot hear the test.
Context: Mic test rejected while a session, room operation or travel is active.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.TestNoMic
RU: Не удалось открыть микрофон. Проверьте устройство и разрешение Windows.
EN: Could not open the microphone. Check your input device and Windows permission.
Context: Exclusive offline capture could not be opened/started.

Name: UI.Voice.Status.TestLocal
RU: Проверка: слышите только вы. Используйте наушники, чтобы избежать обратной связи.
EN: Microphone test: only you can hear it. Use headphones to avoid feedback.
Context: Explicitly requested exclusive offline microphone test; audio is not sent to a room.
